**The eighth release candidate.** It needs [HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.6](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.6) or newer: update HMG-API first.

## What's new since 2.2.0-rc.7

- **More cars:**

  | Region | Cars |
  |---|---|
  | USA 260507 | Kia K5, Sorento (and Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid), Stinger, Soul, Seltos 2021, Niro 2020-22, Cadenza, Telluride 2020-21 (#84, #85); Hyundai Elantra (`CN7PE`) (#88) |
  | Canada 260206 | Kia K5, Sorento, Stinger, Soul, Seltos 2021, Niro 2020-21, Telluride 2020-21 (#85); the newer Kia build: Niro (EV, Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid), Sportage (and Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid), Carnival, Telluride, Forte, Soul, Seltos 2024 (#88) |
  | USA 260206 | Hyundai Ioniq 6 (#88: the same software as the Canadian one) |
  | Korea 260902 | Kia K5 (and Hybrid), Sorento, Stinger, Seltos, Soul, Niro, Mohave, K7, Morning, Ray (#85; HMG-API turns on the hotspot these units lack) |

  A US K5 owner confirmed wireless CarPlay with music (#84). The others haven't been tried on a car yet.
- **Wireless ends when you park and leave** (new setting, on by default): when HMG-API says the car is parked, and before the head unit shuts down, CarPlay or Android Auto ends the way the phone expects, so it takes its audio and calls back at once. Start the car again and the same phone is asked back. When the car's hotspot comes back (after home Wi-Fi, say), the last phone is asked back too (#69).
- **Two phones no longer fight:** the last phone you connected is the one every automatic reconnect is for. Switch by choosing the other phone in Device Connections (#69).
- **The car's "connect a phone" popup no longer crashes** on US and Canadian builds: its Settings button opens Phone Projection's Device Connections page (#86).
- **CarPlay's own log** (new setting, off): for finding out why wireless CarPlay disconnects, with HMG-API's Record a problem. Its lines name your phone, so leave it off unless someone helping you asks (#84).

## What to test

- **A car in the new list:** wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, music, a call. On the Elantra and the Ioniq 6, if the phone finds the car but doesn't connect, turn on the hotspot firewall settings. Then a [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report).
- **Park and leave:** the phone should take its audio back as you walk away, and reconnect when you start the car.
- **Two phones:** connect one, then the other from Device Connections; the first shouldn't come back by itself.
- **The "connect a phone" popup's Settings button** on a US or Canadian car.

## Known issues

- Not checked on any of the older Hyundai models yet (rc.6); the cluster's route-guidance watchdog (#51) and the Bluetooth Audio focus fix (#56) are unchanged.
